cues.text: So in college, I was a government major,
which means I had to write a lot of papers.
Now, when a normal student writes a paper,
they might spread the work out a little like this.
But that is not how my procrastination worked, unfortunately.
The deadline was looming and the consequences were inevitable.
I had an instant gratification monkey living in my brain.
He makes the rational decision maker abandon the plan entirely.
Then the panic monster wakes up and everything changes.
It is the only thing the monkey is terrified of.
Suddenly the deadline seems remarkably close and tangible.
We are all procrastinators to some extent, and that's okay.
